definitions.explanation: A period of twenty-five years. Used to emphasize the length of time, often in retrospective or milestone contexts.

examples.japanese: {四半世紀|しはんせいき}が{過|す}ぎた。
{四半世紀|しはんせいき}ぶりに{故郷|ふるさと}を{訪|おとず}れた。
examples.english: I visited my hometown for the first time in a quarter century.

examples.japanese: この{会社|かいしゃ}は{四半世紀|しはんせいき}にわたって{業界|ぎょうかい}をリードしてきた。
examples.english: This company has led the industry for a quarter century.

notes:
Compound of {四半|しはん} (one quarter) and {世紀|せいき} (century). A somewhat formal expression used in journalism, speeches, and commemorative contexts to emphasize the significance of a 25-year span.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {四半世紀|しはんせいき}が{経|た}つ — a quarter century passes
- {四半世紀|しはんせいき}にわたって — over a quarter century
- {四半世紀|しはんせいき}ぶりに — for the first time in a quarter century
- {約|やく}{四半世紀|しはんせいき} — approximately a quarter century

RELATED WORDS:
- {半世紀|はんせいき} — half a century (50 years)
- {世紀|せいき} — century (100 years)
- {十年|じゅうねん} — decade
- {四半期|しはんき} — quarter (of a year); fiscal quarter
